question: Why did the error rate go up on 04 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The deployment occurred at the right time and place.
why_chain: The error rate increase coincided with the deployment of the new RequestHandler version.
The error rate increase was concentrated in the service auth in region eu-west.
The error rate increase was not observed in other services or regions.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a configuration change that would cause the error rate to increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a dependency issue with an external service.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region eu-west rose from 0.51% to 3.23% (+534%), with a change point at 2026-03-04T08:50:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.10).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region eu-west stayed about the same (373 per 5 min before, 460 per 5 min after, +23%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region eu-west stayed about the same (90 ms before, 91 ms after, +2%).
High error rate on auth in eu-west (auth, eu-west; 10 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v5.21) (auth, eu-west; 16 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v5.21) (auth, eu-west; 20 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v5.21) (auth, eu-west; 27 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: INFO autoscaler: no change (checkout, eu-west; 110 min before the change; record R012; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)

reasons: ✗ No deploy, config change, ticket or alert lines up with the change.
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
missing_data: Deploy and config-change history for the affected segment

actions.action: Roll back the deployment of the new RequestHandler version.
Monitor the RequestHandler version for any other issues before deploying new versions.
Review and update the error handling logic in the RequestHandler.
